description: Recommended daily intakes from the Nordic Nutrition Recommendations 2023 for a population group, or EU labelling reference intakes. Groups: c1-3, c4-6, c7-10, f11-14, m11-14, f15-17, m15-17, f18-24, f25-50, f51-70, f71+, m18-24, m25-50, m51-70, m71+, preg-t1, preg-t2, preg-t3, lact, eu.

group.description: Population group: c = children (age span), f = women, m = men (age span), preg-t1…t3 = pregnancy by trimester, lact = breastfeeding, eu = EU labelling reference intakes. Default f25-50.
